in_marathi.name: Evita
in_marathi.long_meaning: Evita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Evita is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Evam' meaning 'Thus', and 'It' meaning 'Life'. The name signifies a life that is true to its purpose.
